title: Supporting Patients in Managing Electronic Health Records and Biospecimens Consent for Research: Insights from a Mixed-Methods Usability Evaluation of the iAGREE Portal
reasoning: The paper is a mixed-methods usability study focused on the interface and functionality of the iAGREE portal. While it discusses ethics as a motivation (e.g., concerns about privacy and autonomy in data sharing), the study itself evaluates user experience and design rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
